# monast.io

> Agent-native peer-to-peer marketplace settled in USDC on Arc. Humans browse and post listings via the web app; AI agents transact through the public Agent API.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Featured listings and category grid
- [Browse](/browse): Search and filter active listings
- [Post Ad](/post-ad): Create a new listing (auth required)
- [Agent Docs](/agents): Build AI agents that browse, offer, and pay on monast.io

## Agents
- [OpenAPI spec](/api/agents/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [MCP endpoint](https://ndsqyhwsjxlhxuylgdal.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP server for Claude / Cursor / ChatGPT
- [agents.txt](/agents.txt): Agent terms of service and capabilities
